w:r.w:t: SANTA FE BEACH CLUB: A WEB-BASED BEACH RESORT BOOKING AND RESERVATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM

Information technology has greatly improved how businesses serve customers, especially in the tourism and hospitality industry. Web-based reservation systems help make booking faster, easier, and more organized by giving customers real-time access to resort information and availability.

Santa Fe Beach Club is a beach resort that offers accommodations and leisure activities, but its traditional reservation methods may cause booking errors, delays, and inefficient record management. To solve these problems, this study proposes a web-based booking and reservation management system that allows customers to view resort details, check availability, make reservations, and receive confirmations online.

The system will also help resort staff manage bookings, customer records, payments, schedules, and reports through a centralized database. Overall, it aims to improve efficiency, reduce errors, enhance customer convenience, and support the resort’s growth through modern digital technology.

The tourism industry has increasingly shifted toward online services, with travelers now expecting fast and convenient ways to search for destinations and make reservations. In response, many resorts have adopted web-based booking systems to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

Beach resorts contribute to local tourism and economic growth, but many still rely on manual reservation methods that can lead to errors, delays, and poor record management. Santa Fe Beach Club faces similar challenges in handling bookings, availability, and customer information. To address these concerns, this study proposes a web-based booking and reservation management system that will allow customers to make reservations online while enabling administrators to manage bookings, records, payments, and schedules more efficiently. The system is expected to reduce manual work, minimize errors, improve data security, and enhance customer satisfaction

How can the development and implementation of the Santa Fe Beach Club Booking and Reservation Management System modernize the reservation process, streamline front-desk and back-office operations, and enhance overall business efficiency and customer satisfaction?

Guest check-in, check-out, and no-show management
Room type, capacity, pricing, and maintenance management

Role-based access control and two-factor authentication
Reservation, payment, occupancy, and revenue reports
Progressive Web App support for compatible devices

The system shall enforce role-based permissions for administrators and reception staff.

The system shall respond to ordinary user requests within a reasonable period under normal operating conditions.
Room availability and reservation information shall be updated immediately after successful transactions.

The system shall prevent duplicate and overlapping room reservations.

The system shall provide database backup and restoration capabilities.

Booking, payment, check-in, and administrative processes shall use clear instructions and status indicators.
The system shall operate on current versions of Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and other standards-compliant browsers.
The system shall support Windows-based local deployment through XAMPP and compatible web-hosting environments.
Progressive Web App features shall be available only on browsers and devices that support them.
The system shall organize its source code into separate frontend, backend, database, service, and helper components.
Configuration values and credentials shall be stored separately from public source files.
Database changes shall use controlled migration procedures.
System documentation, backup procedures, and security guidelines shall be maintained for future administrators and developers.
